label: About
title: About The Collar Holds Its Shape
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1344 recent saved-signal files and 840 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @viperwave and Color(ed) Theory: Flamin' Red Hots | The Art Institute of Chicago, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Collar Holds Its Shape: Vertical 500:591 low-resolution portrait fragments on black plum. A large side-swept hair-and-eye fragment faces a broad red-orange patterned shoulder across a dark interval. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Hair-and-eye fragment with trailing pink erasure, Red-orange wash across patterned shoulder folds, and Pale stepped pleat with narrow vertical ribs.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
